# git: alias: branches with specific remote

Make the `branches` alias list remote branches too. **Motivation:** "make `git branches` more useful":

```bash
$ git branches # == git branches local
$ git branches remote
# shows branches of the specified remote
```

`branches` is the `for-each-ref --sort=committerdate refs/heads/ …` alias with hash, subject, author and relative date per line; the ask is the same listing over `refs/remotes/<remote>/`.
